description: This file defines the VisibleCodeTracker class, which captures and manages information about visible code in VS Code editors, including visible ranges, cursor positions, and diff info for git files.

classes.name: VisibleCodeTracker
classes.description: A class that tracks visible code in VS Code editors, including capturing visible ranges, cursor positions, and diff info.

methods.name: captureVisibleCode
methods.description: Asynchronously captures the current visible code across all editors, filtering out security concerns and ignored files, and returns a context object.

methods.name: getLastContext
methods.description: Returns the last captured visible code context or null if none has been captured.

methods.name: extractDiffInfo
methods.description: Extracts diff information from a URI, particularly for git-related schemes.
